# FileManager

> **File:** `services/core/FileManager.qml` · **Docs:** see [docs/dev](../../README.md)

Synchronous whole-file reads, for the few places that need a file's contents during a binding or initializer (config, schema, theme, state). Watching and writing stay with FileView.

### Functions

- `read(url)`: Contents of a file (a file:// URL or an absolute path), or null if it can't be read.
